permit.applies: The prospective employer (the self-employed apply themselves).
permit.first: The Ministry of Employment and Social Affairs' approval of post, on proof the post was advertised locally and no local candidate is available.

fees.what: GOP fee per month or part of a month, for the whole duration sought

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles), Gainful Occupation Permit
sources.said: In the first instance an approval certificate for the prospective non-Seychellois employee must be sought from the Ministry of Employment,and Social Affiairs. … The application form is to be completed by the prospective employer. In the case of a self-employed, by the person seeking the permit. … There is a processing fee of SCR. 1,000/‐ for processing of the application. … The fee for the whole duration of the permit being sought at Sr.500 per month or part thereof, is payable when submitting the application. … Gainful occupation permits (GOP) can be collected between 1 - 5 days after submission of application. … The same procedures as per above should be followed for extension of validity of the GOP

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles), GOP List of Fees
sources.said: Nonrefundable processing fee SR 1, 000. 00 … GOP fees per month SR 500. 00

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles), FAQ: GOP Section
sources.said: Employment Certificate is not applicable for Sportsmen, Musician, Short-term medical, major shareholders or Director of a company … What document require for a Short Term GOP? (One Month) … GOP is valid for one month only and are not extendable.

sources.title: Ministry of Employment and Social Affairs (Seychelles), FAQ: Labour Migration
sources.said: The applicant shall be notified of the decision in a minimum period of 3 working days and a maximum period of 9 working days, provided that all the above requirements are met. … advertise the post in a local newspaper or through a Private Employment Agency (b) show proof there is no local candidate available.

note: Two steps: the Ministry of Employment and Social Affairs' approval of post (after the post is advertised locally and no local candidate is shown), then the Gainful Occupation Permit from Immigration. The Immigration FAQ says the employment certificate is not applicable for musicians (and sportsmen, short-term medical staff, major shareholders, directors), but names no actors; a one-month Short Term GOP exists, valid one month only and not extendable. The permit fee is SR 500 for each month or part of a month, paid upfront for the whole duration sought, so the government sets no fixed term in what was read.
